scope: Text, source attribution, factual accuracy, original paraphrase, practical usefulness, and qualitative graphic labels only. No audio, pixel rendering, licensing-artifact or publication QA.

checks.source_attribution: PASS: all ten story sources represented. NVIDIA Nov11 action / Nov12 announcement distinction preserved. Amazon 2025 commitment / today update preserved.
checks.originality: PASS: original concise paraphrases, no quotes or borrowed video represented. No fabricated testing or experiences.
checks.usefulness: PASS: specific routing/audit tasks, eligibility checks and experimental-tool caveats. Three Cloudflare stories are substantively distinct.
checks.graphic_claims: PASS: diagrams qualitative, no fabricated measurements; pricing, future dates and paid-plan limits supported.
